scope: Read-only postprocessing of 24 saved exact continuous truewinner receivers; audit the pre-fixed four original full tensor-grid mixture packets. No oracle, source, threshold or winner rerun.
input: critical_source_tail_arrival_20261007_results.json and its n4/n16/n64 exact profile gzip JSONs, verified against saved hashes
packets: Exactly the four original component measures mu_i=w_i uniform full n-dimensional grid, weights 1/2,1/6,1/6,1/6; M_i=w_i. Coincident physical atoms are fractional assignments summing to the full mu.
qualification: Keep E={saved full M>saved tau}; dominance m_i>=theta*m, fullness m_i>=eta*M_i, equality in paid branch and strict failure in residual. Original complete m denominator throughout.
mass_computation: Only calculate exact closed cube capture at saved winner R from saved complete grid specification and rational x; check sum_i m_i=saved M*R^n. Never search candidates or rebuild a winner.
outputs: full m, all m_i and M_i
q_dom on E and raw qualified capture fraction
dominance-only, fullness-only, both-failure captured fractions and packet counts
analytic_guard: For R<=2, each axis of packet k captures at most 2k+1 atoms, so m_i/M_i<=((2k+1)/(32nk+1))^n. Check this bound and eta comparisons separately; this is a genuine uniform geometry argument, not extrapolation from 24 points.
confidence: Exact Fraction postprocessing, no new seed or probabilistic CI. Receiver probes are deliberately chosen rational points; no point averages interpreted as Lebesgue coverage probabilities or I_dom/I1.
stop_rule: Finish three saved n rounds and etas only. Do not split packets, tune eta/theta, import or rerun old oracle, or start new samples.
